help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  This enhancement gives the slotted power a chance to inflict moderate energy damage when you have Resolve.  The energy damage from Absolute Resolution increases by 30% with each stack of Resolve on the caster.  Additionally, this enhancement reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Guardians and may be slotted into any of their damage powers.
power_display_names: (Guardian) Absolute Resolution: Recharge/Chance for Energy Damage Bonus
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate, Chance for Energy Damage Bonus
